body.text: A small administrative matter, which I have been looking forward to raising.
The last return puts the colony at {param:people} souls. I had the clerk count it twice, in case I had misread it and spoiled my afternoon.

I am obliged to warn you formally that a colony with nobody in it is no longer a colony, and that the Crown does not retake ground it has no reason to want. Consider yourself warned. I have enjoyed it enormously.
Do write back. Your letters are the best thing in my week.

tone.text: I have your note, and I return it {choice}.

options.text: with the count, which I keep myself
and I will take any help the Crown can find
with the observation that clerks are cheap
and I hope you enjoy the next one as much

steps.prompt: What the Chancellor is to carry back

options.label: that the colony will hold
options.text: Tell the court the colony will hold, and that I would welcome anything it cares to send.

options.label: nothing at all
options.text: Tell the court nothing. You have had your afternoon.
